description: Get one customer invoice by id, as Bokio returns it. Use bokio_download_invoice for the PDF and bokio_list_invoice_payments for its payments.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

invoiceId.description: Id from bokio_list_invoices; an unknown id returns a not-found error.

name: bokio_get_invoice
